# Memorandum opinion

## ⟦PERSON|Maren Quill⟧ v. ⟦ORG|Branwick Freight LLC⟧

Case No. ⟦CASE|1:31-cv-00412⟧

1. Plaintiff ⟦PERSON|Maren Quill⟧ sued ⟦ORG|Branwick Freight LLC⟧ for unpaid wages. This court denied an earlier motion in ⟦PERSON|Quill⟧ v. ⟦ORG|Branwick Freight LLC⟧, Case No. ⟦CASE|1:30-cv-00977⟧ (N.D. Cal. 2030).

2. The officers gave the Miranda warnings. Under Easter v. Powell, 467 F.3d 459 (5th Cir. 2031), and Ex parte Tolland, 12 So. 3d 4, a waiver must be express. Id. In Easter the waiver was oral (Thanki & Oppenheimer 4th Edition).
